_provenance.why_this_file_exists: Gate g04_p07 (all_partners_in_tier3, phase_03_gate) requires every partner assigned as lead or contributor in wp_structure.json to exist in this file. The ticket-14 hand-lift populated roles.json but never created partners.json, so the predicate failed with MISSING_MANDATORY_INPUT. This registry is DERIVED from roles.json - it introduces no entity, name, country or role that is not already in the SYN-SPINE-01 spine. It is propagation of an existing logged override, not a new fabrication.
_provenance.note: MSCA-PF is a single-fellow, SINGLE-BENEFICIARY action - it is not a consortium. 'Partner' here means 'a participant identifier referenced by the work-package structure', not 'a consortium beneficiary'. Only HOST is a beneficiary legal entity. FELLOW and SUPERVISOR are natural persons who lead or contribute to work packages; VALIDATION_PARTNER is an associated partner with no beneficiary status.
_provenance.status_vocabulary: validation_status values are exactly the four CLAUDE.md §12.2 categories. 'synthetic' is a descriptive provenance flag, never a status value (see decision_log/status-vocabulary-correction_2026-07-13.json).
